verdict.rationale: Close documents a broad REST API backed by an OpenAPI spec. It covers leads, contacts, activities, opportunities, custom objects and fields, forms, bulk actions, sequences, email/SMS sending, webhooks, the event log and reporting, and an MCP server adds read, write and delete access. However, no source claims or demonstrates full UI parity, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of the dialer/calling, Chloe AI agent control, workflow configuration, permissions/settings administration, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
